name: Royal Enfield Continental GT 650
engine: 648 cc air/oil-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Royal Enfield's 650 cafe racer. Early bikes had a brake caliper corrosion recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2018-2020 bikes are in recall 21V045 (road salt can corrode the brake calipers). Some 2023 bikes are in recall 24V713 (reflectors).
A-002.reason: Corroded calipers can drag or lose braking. Both fixes are free.

recalls.what: Road salt can corrode the brake calipers, making them drag or brake poorly.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front and rear calipers free.

recalls.what: Side and rear reflectors don't meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the side and rear reflectors free.
